Product Analyst
Spinny
Gurugram, Haryana, India (On-site)

About Spinny:
Spinny is India's most trusted platform for buying and selling certified used cars.

Key Tasks:
• Partner with APMs and PMs to track feature adoption, funnel conversion, and bounce rates.
• Build executive dashboards in Google Analytics, Mixpanel, and Tableau.
• Write advanced SQL queries to analyze multi-touch attribution.

Requirements:
• 0-2 years of analytics experience. Freshers with strong SQL & Python skills welcome.
• Bachelor's degree in engineering, commerce, or statistics.
• On-site presence in Gurgaon office required.
